selection_rule: Word-level transliteration and per-word timing are required for highlighting, but only from a source that the app may redistribute. No source has passed the rights review yet, so the adapter seam is implemented and off. To enable one: register an adapter with this source_id in ezber_pipeline/sources/word_level.py, set active_source, set the exact license id in licenses/registry.json, and set timing_target to the reciter whose recordings the timing aligns to (when the source carries timings).

candidates.note: Quranic Universal Library word-by-word transliteration datasets. Per-resource licensing, sign-in-gated downloads, no public API; rights review pending.

cpfair/quran-align word timings (MIT, last updated 2017). A timing-only candidate once a redistributable transliteration source and cleared recordings exist; must be re-validated against the current recordings.
